title: Patch: the card detail view and the account screen load when first opened, not in the first page load
thread:
**Issue #4517 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4517: Patch: the card detail view and the account screen load when first opened, not in the first page load
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Every visitor's first download carries two parts of the site that most visits never open. One is the large card view that opens when you click a card, with its patch history and win-rate box. The other is the account settings screen. The home page was written to fetch the card view only on the first click. But a shortcut elsewhere in the code has pulled it into the first download ever since that was written, and nothing noticed. Once this is built, both arrive only when a player heads for them, fetched early as soon as a pointer or finger shows interest. The home page comes up a little sooner on a phone. A new test also stops a later 'load it only when needed' from being undone without anyone noticing.

## Why

**The card view's lazy load has never worked.**
- `routes/landing.tsx:59-60` loads the detail dialog with `lazy()`, `so the first screen stays light` (added in 53f323cace, 2026-10-03).
- It never took effect. `cards/inspect/index.ts:9` re-exports `CardDetail` (since 5694c06843, 2026-09-24), and `cards/index.ts:38` re-exports it again. `main.tsx:67` imports `FullScreenArtHost` from `cards/index.ts`, so `CardDetail.tsx` is in the entry's static graph. The build therefore keeps it in the entry chunk, and the dynamic import resolves to code that is already loaded.
- No test names it (`routes/landing*.test.*`).

**What it drags in.** These figures come from a static walk of the import graph from `main.tsx`, over source files, gzipping comment-stripped source. The minified saving will be smaller, and the build measures the real one.
- Dropping the re-export takes 17 modules out of the first load:
  - `CardDetail.tsx` and `VoicePreview.tsx`;
  - nine `patches/` modules (`CardHistory`, `ChangeList`, `diff.ts`, `releases.ts`, `history.ts`, `source.ts` and others) with `patches.css`;
  - `stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx`, with `TierChip`, `stats/patches.ts` and `tier.css`.
- That is 89,526 bytes of TS (about 18.9 KB gzipped) and 26,361 bytes of CSS (about 5.8 KB gzipped). CSS is never tree-shaken.
- The patch history that #3499 kept out of the first load now rides in with the view that shows it.

**The account screen is static by choice, but only sign-out needs to be.**
- The reason is in `main.tsx:96-98`: the gate's own panels offer Sign out, which must work when nothing else has loaded.
- That needs only `signOut`, `signOutLabel` and `useSigningOut` (`routes/account.tsx:166-245`). These are also the only names that `auth/UsernamePrompt.tsx:11`, `auth/ConsentPrompt.tsx:14`, `routes/login.tsx:82` and `routes/invite.tsx:36` take from it.
- The screen itself draws only at `/account`, inside `<EngineGate>` (`main.tsx:690-695`), which already waits for the 2.31 MB engine module.
- Moving the three helpers to their own module frees 21 more modules: `account.tsx`, `account.css`, `TwoStepSettings`, `LinkedAccounts`, `ChangeEmail`, `NotificationSettings`, `RankCrest`, `StreakFlame`, the portrait files and others. That is about 100 KB of TS (about 19.7 KB gzipped) and 19,802 bytes of CSS (about 5.2 KB gzipped). `daily/push.ts` stays, because sign-out calls it.

**For scale:** the first load measured 413,393 bytes gzipped at #4444's lowering (`net/first-load.test.ts:77-83`), and #4444 itself saved 6,988 bytes.

**Nothing guards this kind of slip.**
- `first-load.test.ts` names the modules it keeps out (the drawer panels, `sfx.ts`, the scene data). A lazy import that a barrel defeats passes every check.
- The same graph walk finds exactly three `import()` targets already in the entry's static graph: this one, `i18n.ts → cards/chinese.ts` and `main.tsx → audio/sfxLoader.ts`.
- The last two are small loaders (11.8 KB and 2.5 KB raw) that sit in the entry on purpose. Their payloads sit behind lazy globs that the test already guards.

## Proposal

1. **Card view.** Drop `CardDetail` from both barrels.
   - Its named users import `cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx` directly, as `patches/PatchNotes.tsx` and several tests already do. They are `packs/PackOpening.tsx`, `collection/OwnedCards.tsx`, `collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx` and `game/deckbuilder/CardBrowser.tsx` (all lazy screens already), plus the tests that take it through a barrel.
   - The landing fan starts the dialog's chunk on pointer, touch or focus intent on a fan card: once per page load, and not while the browser asks to save data. This copies `together/friendsDrawerChunk.ts` (#4444).
2. **Account screen.** Move the three sign-out helpers, and `resetSigningOutForTests`, to a module of their own (say `auth/signOut.ts`) that imports nothing from `routes/account.tsx`. Their five importers take them from there.
   - `/account` renders through a new `routeChunks.account` entry, part of R2116000's single map. `chunkAt` already maps it through `paths.account`.
   - So `startScreen` (R2630001) asks for the screen's code as the gate mounts, alongside the engine module rather than after it.
   - Update the comment at `main.tsx:96-97`.
3. **Guards** in `net/first-load.test.ts`:
   - A source test that walks the static import graph from `main.tsx` (value imports and re-exports; `import type` and `export type` skipped). It fails when any non-test `import()` target is in that graph, naming the importer and the target. `cards/chinese.ts` and `audio/sfxLoader.ts` are the only loaders allowed there, each listed with its reason.
   - A built test that the entry chunk and its preloads hold no card-history or account-screen text, with strings picked the way #4444's test picks them.
   - The budget lowered to CI's new measurement, as each earlier lowering was.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/index.ts`, `apps/web/src/cards/index.ts`, `apps/web/src/routes/landing.tsx` (the intent prefetch), and the four named importers above.
- A new `apps/web/src/auth/signOut.ts`, plus `routes/account.tsx`, `main.tsx`, `routes/chunks.tsx`, `auth/UsernamePrompt.tsx`, `auth/ConsentPrompt.tsx`, `routes/login.tsx` and `routes/invite.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/net/first-load.test.ts`, and the tests that import `CardDetail` through a barrel: `game/Dialog.test.tsx`, `cards/flavour.test.tsx` and `cards/inspect/CardDetail.test.tsx`.
- No SPEC change and no ruling. When code loads is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The card view still opens on a click or a tap, as R639 states.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Neither `cards/inspect/index.ts` nor `cards/index.ts` names `CardDetail`, and no module reachable statically from `main.tsx` value-imports `cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx`.
- [ ] A click or a tap on a landing fan card still opens its detail view, and the existing `routes/landing.test.tsx` cases pass.
- [ ] Pointer, touch or focus intent on a fan card starts the dialog's chunk once per page load, never while saving data, held by a test.
- [ ] `signOut`, `signOutLabel` and `useSigningOut` live in a module that imports nothing from `routes/account.tsx`, and `routes/account.tsx` is reached only through `routeChunks.account`.
- [ ] The gate's Sign out still signs out when the account chunk fails to load, held by a test that rejects the chunk and presses it.
- [ ] `/account` still opens behind the same `Gated allowPending consentExempt engine` and `EngineGate`, and `startScreen` for `/account` asks for the account chunk, held by a test.
- [ ] The new source test fails on today's tree, naming `routes/landing.tsx → cards/inspect/CardDetail.tsx`, and passes after the change. It allows only `cards/chinese.ts` and `audio/sfxLoader.ts`, each with its reason.
- [ ] The built test finds no card-history or account-screen text in the entry chunk or its preloads.
- [ ] `FIRST_LOAD_GZIP_BUDGET_BYTES` is lowered to CI's new measurement (`vite build --mode development`) plus the usual 2–3% headroom, and its comment records the measured bytes. Putting either module back would cross it.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` on the touched files, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` pass.

## Size and risks

Medium: about 15 files, all in `apps/web`, with no engine, server or spec change. The source-level estimate is about 49 KB gzipped of TS and CSS before minification. The minified saving is smaller, and CI's build gives the real figure.

Risks:
1. On a slow network, a first click on a fan card waits for the chunk. The intent prefetch and the landing's existing Suspense boundary cover this.
2. A direct visit to `/account` fetches one more chunk. It starts alongside the much larger engine module, so it adds no wait of its own.
3. Sign out must keep working when every lazy chunk has failed, which is why it was static. The move keeps it in the first load, and an acceptance test holds it there.
4. The graph walk reads imports with regexes over source, like the file's existing checks. It cannot see an import specifier built at runtime, and the client uses none outside `import.meta.glob`.
```
